messages:
elaine: FYI ran into duplicate-create bugs from the py async client when the upstream returned intermittent 504s. request retried but server processed both.

sam: any logs/repro?

elaine: repro uses an async generator for the request body and we pass idempotency_key. when httpx raised `RemoteProtocolError` our retry sent an attempt that lacked the Idempotency-Key header. stack shows the generator raised mid-stream.

marek: streaming bodies are not rewindable by default. are we buffering?

elaine: nope. code does `await client._transport.request(...)` and on exception we reconstruct request and retry. the rebuild path seems to drop some headers.

jun: that explains it. two problems: 1) one-shot streams can't be replayed; 2) header copy when rebuilding failed.

linda: i'll submit a fix to ensure headers are copied atomically when we build a retry request and add a small in-memory buffer option for streams under config `buffer_on_retry`. also adding a unit test that simulates mid-stream failure and asserts idempotency header persists.

sam: short-term mitigation: docs + sample app to recommend customers either avoid streaming for create endpoints or always supply an idempotency_key and set `buffer_on_retry=True`. also don't retry non-idempotent endpoints unless key present.

marek: avoid heuristics on 5xx. instead expose per-route retry policy and a `retry_on_unconfirmed` flag allowing conservative defaults.

elaine: action items:
- linda: PR for header-copy + test (ETA EOD)
- sam: sample-app + docs with `wrap_stream_for_replay` helper (ETA tomorrow)
- marek: transport option `buffer_on_retry` (ETA next week)
- jun: pipeline test to catch header regressions (ETA 2 days)

devex-bot: @here opened issue #INV-3422: "py-sdk: async transport drops idempotency header when replaying streamed request" and linked draft PR.

elaine: sample log excerpt for issue:
REQUEST 1 HEADERS: {"Authorization": "Bearer ...", "Idempotency-Key": "uuid-abc-123"}
REQUEST 2 HEADERS: {"Authorization": "Bearer ..."}  # missing Idempotency-Key

sam: once PRs merge cut a patch release 0.12.3 and include migration notes.

linda: PR submitted and tests attached.

elaine: thanks all, will update the customer and post release notes when cut. :tada:
